title: Flood in Japan
footprint_method: GDACS reported flood event/affected-area polygon · center-aligned context feature

geometry_qc.scientific_interpretation: Selected GDACS flood geometry is a reported event/affected-area context feature; it is not interpreted as observed or modelled inundation extent.
geometry_qc.selection_policy: single GDACS polygon feature aligned to the reported event coordinate; unrelated polygon features are not unioned

scientific_note: This compact geometry is simplified for browser display. Exposure calculations use the unsimplified mapped source footprint. Wildfire perimeter admission requires GDACS/GWIS source provenance, same-episode alignment and coarse area-consistency QC. Flood polygons remain reported event/affected-area context and are not interpreted as observed inundation.
